summary: Nocera, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose two compensatory agreements: a consulting agreement with Chien-Hua Tseng for AI advisory services, providing 50,000 shares upon signing and 50,000 shares after one year; and an employment agreement appointing Shun-Chih Chuang as CFO with an $84,000 annual salary and 100,000 shares per year. Both are standard retention/compensation arrangements, not special-situation events. No board recommendation, deal terms, or strategic transaction involved. Routine current report; no special-situation classification warranted.
